Preconditions: Dedicated punchout buyer @td(PUNCHOUT_MAPPING_REQUISITION.externalId) (one organization, own account); Punchout.Enabled on for the configuration-0 store; desktop viewport 1920x1080. --- SCREEN: catalog ---
